phases.name: Create Composio Auth Config
steps: Navigate to the Composio dashboard auth configs section.
Click Create Auth Config and select OAuth2.
Copy the provided redirect URI for your provider portal.
phases.handoff: Copy the redirect URI from Composio to use in your provider app registration.

phases.name: Register App in Developer Portal
steps: Register a new application in the provider developer portal.
Retrieve the Client ID and Client Secret.
phases.handoff: Paste Client ID and Client Secret back into the Composio dashboard.
